A Merry Bee

Joseph Skipsey (1832–1903)

A 
GOLDEN
 bee a-cometh
O’er the mere, glassy mere,
And a merry tale he hummeth
In my ear.
How he seized and kiss’d a blossom
From its true thorny tree,
Pluck’d and placed in Annie’s bosom,
Hums the bee!
